summary.whatChanges: Test-infrastructure only changes to Vitest's Playwright UI e2e suite: CI now uploads Playwright trace artifacts, a new skipped-test fixture is added (bumping expected counts), viewport sizing moves from global config to per-spec, explorer rows are opened via direct click/dispatch instead of hover+button, and filter assertions now check explorer summary counts including a new "Only Tests" case.
behaviorChanges: CI runs upload a `playwright-traces-<os>-node-<version>` artifact (1-day retention) from test/ui/test-results when the unit suite finishes, ignored if absent.
The UI test fixture project gains a `skipped.test.ts` file, so fixture totals become 2 skipped tests and 1 skipped file.
Playwright's default Desktop Chrome viewport is restored globally; ui.spec.ts sets 800x1600 itself and the scroll test grows to 1000x2000.
risks: Explorer assertions depend on hard-coded viewport heights; adding fixture files can push rows out of the virtual scroller's render window and cause flaky failures (acknowledged in the added comments).
Replacing hover + 'btn-open-details' click with a plain row click in merge-reports.spec removes coverage of the details button affordance.
Using dispatchEvent('click') bypasses Playwright actionability checks, so genuinely unclickable/obscured rows would no longer be caught.
Trace artifacts are uploaded on every non-cancelled unit matrix job, adding CI storage/upload time.
